parsed.rationale: The second participating record lives at `Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift`, which sits under the `Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/` directory — a sample-app location that triggers the sample-app-mirror restraint regardless of the `is_sample_app` flag value.
